title: Discovery of novel JAK1 inhibitors through combining machine learning, structure-based pharmacophore modeling and bio-evaluation.
summary: ML and structure-based pharmacophore screening identify JAK1 inhibitor candidates; four purchasable compounds were bio-evaluated and Z-10 showed kinase inhibition (IC50 194.9 nM). Experimental biochemical validation supports a specific inhibitor candidate; no therapeutic efficacy is claimed. AI role: Machine-learning classifiers with pharmacophore screening. The article appeared in Journal Of Translational Medicine.
